 Australia vs England 1st T20I: Live streaming, playing XI, head to head, weather and pitch report
 SECTIONS Australia vs England 1st T20I: Live streaming, playing XI, head to head, weather and pitch report By Trending Desk , ET Online Last Updated: Nov 21, 2026, 12:19:00 PM IST Rate Story Follow us Share Font Size Abc Small Abc Medium Abc Large Save Print Comment Synopsis Australia vs England 1st T20I Playing XI, Live Streaming: Australia will take on England in the first T20I of the five-match series at the Melbourne Cricket Ground on November 21. Check match details, live streaming in India, probable playing XIs, head-to-head records, MCG pitch report and Melbourne weather forecast.
 AP Australia vs England 1st T20I: Check live streaming details, probable playing XI, head-to-head record, MCG pitch report, weather forecast and match timings. Australia and England are set to renew their rivalry as they begin a five-match T20 International series on Saturday, November 21. The opening match will be played at the Melbourne Cricket Ground (MCG), with both sides looking to start the series on a winning note. England will enter the T20I series with confidence after defeating Australia 2-1 in the preceding three-match ODI series. Harry Brook and his teammates will now aim to carry that momentum into the shortest format.
 Australia, meanwhile, will be keen to bounce back on home soil. Mitchell Marsh will lead the hosts, who have several fresh faces in their T20I squad. The contest also promises an interesting battle between two evenly matched sides. Australia and England have won 12 T20Is each in their 26 completed encounters, while two matches ended without a result.
Here is everything you need to know about the Australia vs England 1st T20I , including live streaming details, probable playing XIs, head-to-head records, weather conditions and the MCG pitch report . 
 Australia vs England 1st T20I: Match details
 Match: Australia vs England, 1st T20I
 Date: Saturday, November 21, 2026
 Venue: Melbourne Cricket Ground, Melbourne
 Time: 1:45 PM IST
 Toss: 1:15 PM IST
 Australia captain: Mitchell Marsh
 England captain: Harry Brook
 Australia vs England 1st T20I: Where to watch live streaming in India?
Cricket fans in India can watch the Australia vs England 1st T20I live on the Star Sports Network. The online live streaming of the match will be available on the JioHotstar app and website.
In Australia, viewers can follow the match on Fox Cricket and Kayo Sports. Fans in the UK can watch the series on TNT Sports.
 Live Events
 Australia vs England 1st T20I: Probable playing XIs
 Australia probable playing XI: 
 Mitchell Marsh (c), Jake Fraser-McGurk, Sam Harper (wk), Mitchell Owen, Tim David, Jack Edwards, Nikhil Chaudhary, Ben Dwarshuis, Spencer Johnson, Adam Zampa, Billy Stanlake.
 England probable playing XI: 
Phil Salt (wk), Tom Banton, Will Jacks, Harry Brook (c), Jordan Cox, Sam Curran, Jamie Overton, Liam Dawson, Adil Rashid, Luke Wood, Henry Crocombe.
Australia have suffered some setbacks ahead of the T20I series. Fast bowlers Mahli Beardman, Xavier Bartlett and Nathan Ellis are unavailable because of injuries. Billy Stanlake has been called up as a replacement.
England, meanwhile, have rested several frontline fast bowlers, including Jofra Archer, Gus Atkinson and Sonny Baker. The visitors will also have opportunities to test their bench strength during the five-match series.
 Australia vs England head-to-head record in T20Is
Australia and England have a closely contested T20I rivalry. The two teams have played 26 completed T20 Internationals. Australia have won 12 matches, while England have also registered 12 victories. Two encounters ended without a result. Three additional matches were abandoned before the toss.
 Australia vs England T20I head-to-head: 
 Total completed matches: 26
 Australia won: 12
 England won: 12
 No result: 2
 Australia vs England 1st T20I pitch report: How will MCG surface behave?
The Melbourne Cricket Ground generally offers a balanced surface, with good bounce and pace for fast bowlers. Batters who settle down can also make the most of the conditions. The large dimensions of the ground, however, mean that clearing the boundary might not always be straightforward.
Fast bowlers could find some assistance with the new ball, particularly during the initial overs. Spinners may also become important as the match progresses. Historical T20I numbers at the venue suggest that chasing teams have enjoyed an advantage. Of the 20 completed T20 Internationals played at the MCG, teams batting second have won 12, compared with seven victories for teams batting first.
The average first-innings score at the venue is around 144. The toss could therefore play an important role, with the captain winning it potentially considering bowling first.
 Australia vs England 1st T20I weather report: Will rain interrupt the match?
Weather conditions are unlikely to cause significant disruption to the opening T20I, according to the Australian Bureau of Meteorology forecast for Melbourne. The forecast indicates no rain during the evening hours, with the chance of rainfall falling to zero per cent at 5 pm and 8 pm local time on Saturday.
Temperatures are expected to be around 20 degrees Celsius at 8 pm, making conditions relatively comfortable for an evening match. There is no major rain threat at present, and fans can expect favourable conditions for a full game.
 What happened in the Australia vs England ODI series?
England will have the psychological advantage heading into the T20I series after winning the preceding ODI contest 2-1. Australia started the series with a victory in Perth. However, England responded strongly in Adelaide and Hobart, winning the next two matches to clinch the series.
The visitors will now look to maintain their winning momentum, while Australia will be determined to deliver a stronger performance in the T20 format.
